whatAre.title: What Are Cookies
whatAre.description1: As is common practice with almost all professional websites, Nestleo uses cookies, which are small files that are downloaded to your device, to improve your experience.
whatAre.description2: This page describes what information they gather, how we use it, and why we sometimes need to store these cookies. We will also share how you can prevent these cookies from being stored, however, this may downgrade or 'break' certain elements of the site's functionality.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.description: We use cookies for a variety of reasons detailed below. Unfortunately, in most cases, there are no industry standard options for disabling cookies without completely disabling the functionality and features they add to this site.

account.title: Account related cookies
account.description: If you create an account with us, we will use cookies for the management of the signup process and general administration. These cookies will usually be deleted when you log out, however in some cases they may remain afterward to remember your site preferences when logged out.

login.title: Login related cookies
login.description: We use cookies when you are logged in so that we can remember this fact. This prevents you from having to log in every single time you visit a new page. These cookies are typically removed or cleared when you log out to ensure that you can only access restricted features and areas when logged in.

preferences.title: Site preferences cookies
preferences.description: In order to provide you with a great experience on this site, we provide the functionality to set your preferences for how this site runs when you use it. In order to remember your preferences, we need to set cookies so that this information can be called whenever you interact with a page is affected by your preferences.

thirdParty.title: Third Party Cookies
thirdParty.description: In some special cases, we also use cookies provided by trusted third parties. The following section details which third party cookies you might encounter through this site.
thirdParty.analytics: This site uses Google Analytics which is one of the most widespread and trusted analytics solutions on the web for helping us to understand how you use the site and ways that we can improve your experience.
thirdParty.social: We also use social media buttons and/or plugins on this site that allow you to connect with your social network in various ways. For these to work, the social media sites will set cookies through our site which may be used to enhance your profile on their site or contribute to the data they hold for various purposes outlined in their respective privacy policies.

moreInfo.title: More Information
moreInfo.description1: Hopefully that has clarified things for you and as was previously mentioned if there is something that you aren't sure whether you need or not it's usually safer to leave cookies enabled in case it does interact with one of the features you use on our site.
moreInfo.description2: If you are still looking for more information then you can contact us through one of our preferred contact methods.

intro.title: Privacy Policy for Nestleo
intro.description1: At Nestleo, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy document contains information that is collected and recorded by Nestleo and how we use it.
intro.description2: If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@nestleo.com.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description1: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you register on the platform, express an interest in obtaining information about us or our products and services, participate in activities on the platform, or otherwise contact us.
collection.description2: The personal information that we collect depends on the context of your interactions with us and the platform, the choices you make, and the products and features you use. The personal information we collect may include the following:

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.description: We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:
usage.item1: Provide, operate, and maintain our platform
usage.item2: Improve, personalize, and expand our platform
usage.item3: Understand and analyze how you use our platform
usage.item4: Develop new products, services, features, and functionality
usage.item5: Communicate with you, including for customer service, updates about our platform, and other information

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.item3: Request deletion of your personal data
rights.item4: Object to our use and processing of your personal data
rights.item5: Request restriction of processing your personal data
rights.item6: Request transfer of your personal data

security.title: Security of Your Personal Information
security.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect the security of any personal information we process. However, despite our safeguards and efforts to secure your information, no electronic transmission over the Internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.description: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.description: Our support team is here to help you with any questions you might have about our services.

1.question: What services does Nestleo provide?
1.answer: Nestleo is a comprehensive property management platform that offers services for property owners, landlords, and tenants. Our services include property listing management, tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance request handling, and a complete communication system between tenants and landlords. We also provide analytics and reporting tools to help property owners optimize their rental business.

2.question: How do I get started with Nestleo?
2.answer: Getting started with Nestleo is simple. Create an account, select your role (property owner/manager or tenant), and choose a subscription plan that fits your needs. Property owners can immediately start adding properties, while tenants can browse available listings. Our onboarding process guides you through each step, and our support team is available if you need assistance. Most users are fully set up within 15 minutes.

3.question: Is my data secure on your platform?
3.answer: Security is our top priority. We employ bank-level encryption for all sensitive data, including personal information and payment details. Our platform is compliant with industry standards for data protection, and we regularly conduct security audits. We never share your information with third parties without your consent, and you always retain control over your data. Additionally, we implement multi-factor authentication and advanced threat protection to safeguard your account.

4.question: What subscription plans do you offer?
4.answer: We offer tiered subscription plans designed for different needs: Basic for individuals with 1-3 properties, Standard for small portfolios of 4-10 properties, and Premium for larger portfolios with unlimited properties. Each tier includes progressively more features, from basic property management tools to advanced analytics and priority support. We also offer monthly and annual billing options, with annual subscriptions providing a 20% discount.

5.question: Can I change my subscription plan later?
5.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your subscription plan at any time through your account settings. Upgrades take effect immediately, with pro-rated billing for the remainder of your current billing cycle. Downgrades become effective at the end of your current billing period. All your data and settings are preserved when changing plans, ensuring a seamless transition between subscription levels.

6.question: How do I list a new property?
6.answer: Listing a new property is simple. From your dashboard, click Add Property and follow the guided process. You'll enter property details (address, size, features), upload photos, set rental terms, and specify tenant requirements. Our system helps optimize your listing with recommended pricing based on market data. Once complete, you can publish immediately to start receiving applications, or save as a draft to finish later.

7.question: How are maintenance requests handled?
7.answer: Our maintenance management system streamlines the entire process. Tenants submit requests through the app, including descriptions and photos of the issue. Property owners or managers are immediately notified and can communicate directly with tenants, assign contractors, track progress, and approve estimates—all within the platform. The system also maintains a complete history of maintenance activities for each property, helping you track expenses and identify recurring issues.

8.question: Can I use Nestleo on mobile devices?
8.answer: Yes, Nestleo is fully optimized for mobile use. We offer both a responsive web application that works on any device and dedicated mobile apps for iOS and Android. Through our mobile platform, you can access all features including property management, maintenance requests, messaging, document signing, and rent payments. Push notifications keep you updated on important events, allowing you to manage your properties or rental experience from anywhere.

reviews.title: Why choose Nestleo
reviews.description: Built for modern building managers, Nestleo simplifies voting, meetings, billing and claims - all in one secure platform.

1.content: Nestleo completely transformed how I manage my rental properties. The tenant screening saved me from at least two potentially problematic tenants, and the maintenance request system has cut my response time in half. My tenants love the platform too!
1.author: Michael Roberts

2.content: As a property manager handling over 30 units, Nestleo has been a game-changer. The automated rent collection has virtually eliminated late payments, and the dashboard gives me a complete overview of all properties at a glance. Worth every penny!
2.author: Jennifer Sanchez

3.content: I was skeptical about switching to a digital platform for my rental business, but Nestleo made the transition incredibly smooth. Their customer support team guided me through the entire setup process, and now I can't imagine managing my properties without it.
3.author: Robert Chen

4.content: The financial reporting tools in Nestleo have saved me countless hours each month. I can generate detailed income statements, track expenses, and even prepare tax documents with just a few clicks. My accountant is just as impressed as I am!
4.author: Sarah Johnson

5.content: As someone who was new to property investing, I needed a system that was easy to use but still comprehensive. Nestleo exceeded my expectations with their intuitive interface and excellent onboarding process. I've recommended it to all my investor friends.
5.author: David Thompson
